tasks.title: QUOTE function doesn't work as expected on tables that are utf16

classification.basis: Exact saved kind mapping; not execution readiness

source_review_decision.reason: latin1与utf16两表NULL/NOTNULL样例完整，可用HEX和字符集元数据排除客户端乱码。

test_spec.setup: 分别创建正文varchar32 latin1与utf16表，插入NULL及NOTNULL，客户端utf8mb4。
test_spec.oracle: QUOTE(NULL)输出应为正确字符集的NULL文本而非乱码；不能混淆SQL NULL与字符串NULL。
test_spec.target_applicability: 目标支持utf16列及QUOTE；8.1修复不能跨分支推断8.0已修。

comments.author: Christine Cole
comments.text:
Posted by developer:
 
Fixed as of the upcoming MySQL 8.1.0 release, and here's the proposed changelog entry from the documentation team:

The Quote() function returned unexpected results with columns selected
from a table having the utf16 character set.

Thank you for the bug report.
